review_notes: Reviewed the full target file and checked its boundary-inclusion uses in SolidTorusNeighborhood/Exterior. The existing projection and frontier simp lemmas appear to rewrite in useful directions; the one suggested change is limited to a private rewrite used repeatedly in this file.

findings.excerpt:
private theorem tangentVector_circleExp (f : Circle → V) (t : ℝ) :
    tangentVector f (Circle.exp t) = deriv (f ∘ Circle.exp) t := by
findings.problem: This provides the canonical simplification of the velocity at an exponential-parametrized point, but is not in the simp set. The file consequently invokes it manually at two later uses.
findings.proposed_change: Add the `[simp]` attribute to `tangentVector_circleExp`, keeping its current left-to-right orientation so `tangentVector f (Circle.exp t)` simplifies to the derivative expression.
findings.benefit: The normal form is the derivative already used in the proofs, and simp can perform the conversion at the existing occurrences without explicit rewrites. The proposed direction does not unfold the derivative back into the definition of `tangentVector`.
